title: Efficient re-sampling in quasi-probability decompositions
summary: Near-term quantum devices are limited by noise and hardware constraints, motivating algorithmic approaches that trade circuit complexity for increased sampling overhead. Quasi-probability decompositions (QPDs), for example, allow replacing non-local operations by multiple circuits with local operations, but the associated sampling overhead generally scales exponentially and limits their practicality. In this work, we introduce a reweighting strategy for QPDs for circuits with the same variational structure across parameter settings, reusing samples and thereby reducing the sampling overhead.…
